note: UnionPay demo POS config library. Hand-authored (no vendor source XML), unlike the Amex set. Loaded by backend/emv_host/cases/loader.py (index.json is metadata only).

configs.note: term only: the device factory TERM (assets/emv/params TERM= 9F6604360000809F1A0201569F7A0101) with 9F66 (TTQ) overridden to 36804000 so the reader requests an online cryptogram (QPB-B-002-01). 9F1A/9F7A are kept because the POS applies CONFIG.TERM with setTerminalParam, i.e. the whole terminal parameter set is replaced.
